rows: A phrase of the form "the F" — existence + uniqueness + predication
How does Russell analyze "The F is G"?
Why is "The present king of France is bald" false?
The existential clause is false — no king exists
What is a logically proper name?
A term referring directly via acquaintance — only demonstratives ("this") qualify
What did Russell say about ordinary names like "Aristotle"?
They are disguised descriptions, not genuine names
World = atomic facts; language mirrors structure; analysis reveals atomic form
The set of all sets not members of themselves leads to contradiction
